title: 第15章 学射第16章 小吉 金石潭游鱼
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第15章学射
没有狗皮袄，江尘一出门就觉得冷了几分。
还好刚入冬没几天，还能顶得住；
要是再冷些，家里得生火取暖，那时打的柴肯定就不能卖了，只能待在家里窝冬。
俗话说“春耕夏种，秋收冬闲”
看似冬天最闲，实则对荒年百姓来说，冬天反倒是最难熬的。
要是收成不好，过冬的存粮不够，连野菜都挖不到；
加上天冷需要柴取暖，冻死人、饿死人是常事。
想着有的没的，江尘已经带着江能文走到昨日放套索的位置。
连续看了三个套索，全都一无所获。
积雪渐渐融化，此前兔子留下的脚印也看不见了。
“啊……怎么什么都没有！”
江能文颇为失望。
“打猎果然没那么容易啊。”
江尘倒是早有心理准备。
这才是猎户的常态——十猎九空。
他没动套索，又在每个必经之路旁放了几粒粟米。
江尘还带了铲子，想着要是天气允许，就上山挖那两株天麻。
可走到半山腰，两腿就开始打颤，江能文也开始淌鼻涕。
寒风太烈，他只有一件棉衣，要登上小黑山顶实在顶不住。

略一思索，江尘就放弃了——这大冬天的，去山顶人少，就算他今日不去，应该也没人挖走。
“二叔，要不要去山鸡窝看看。”
“行。”
江尘其实没抱什么希望，但上山一趟，就当去走走了。
到了第一次发现野鸡的山坳，果然除了散落的鸡毛，完全没什么收获。
江能文撇着嘴，一脸委屈。
“行了，要是上山就能抓到兔子山鸡，那不是家家户户天天都能吃肉了。”
“好吧。”
江能文只得应了一句。
可惜他抓兔子的雄心壮志完全没有用武之地。
当日，江尘第一次空手下山。
此时，陈巧翠却正在另一片林地挖野菜。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Learning to Shoot
Without a dog-skin coat, Jiang Chen felt a bit cold as soon as he went out.
Fortunately, it’s just a few days into winter and I can still withstand it;
If it gets colder and the family has to light a fire to keep warm, the firewood they collect will definitely not be sold and they will have to stay at home for the winter.
As the saying goes, "Spring plows and summer sows, autumn harvests and winter is idle."
It seems that winter is the most leisurely, but in fact, for people in famine years, winter is the most difficult to endure.
If the harvest is not good, there is not enough food stored for the winter, and even wild vegetables cannot be dug;
In addition, when the weather is cold and firewood is needed for heating, it is common for people to freeze to death and starve to death.
Thinking that there was nothing left, Jiang Chen had already led Jiang Nengwen to the place where the noose was placed yesterday.
I looked at three nooses in a row and found nothing.
The snow gradually melted, and the footprints left by the rabbit were no longer visible.
"Ah...why there's nothing!"
Jiang Nengwen was quite disappointed.
"Hunting is really not that easy."
Jiang Chen was already mentally prepared.
This is the normal state of Orion—hunting ten times and nine times empty.
He didn't move the noose, and placed a few grains of corn beside each path he had to pass.
Jiang Chen also brought a shovel, thinking that if the weather permitted, he would go up the mountain to dig out the two Gastrodia elata plants.
But halfway up the mountain, his legs began to tremble, and Jiang Nengwen also started to have runny nose.
The cold wind was so strong that he only had a cotton-padded coat, and he couldn't stand it when he climbed to the top of Xiaohei Mountain.
After thinking for a while, Jiang Chen gave up - it was winter, and there were few people going to the top of the mountain. Even if he didn't go today, there would probably be no one to dig him out.
"Second uncle, would you like to go to the pheasant nest and have a look?"
"Okay."
Jiang Chen actually didn't have much hope, but once he went up the mountain, he just treated it as a walk.
When we arrived at the mountain col where we first discovered pheasants, we found nothing but scattered chicken feathers.
Jiang Nengwen curled his lips and looked aggrieved.
"Okay, if you can catch rabbits and pheasants by going up the mountain, then not every household can eat meat every day."
"Okay."
Jiang Nengwen could only respond.
Unfortunately, his ambition to catch rabbits was completely useless.
That day, Jiang Chen went down the mountain empty-handed for the first time.
At this time, Chen Qiaocui was digging wild vegetables in another forest.
